tasks.label: replace-inline
replace-inline2
tasks.command:
python -c "import pathlib; path=pathlib.Path('index.html'); data=path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'); anchor='<script src="https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.12.2/firebase-storage-compat.js"></script>'; idx=data.find(anchor);
if idx != -1:
    start = idx + len(anchor)
    rest = data[start:]
    script_marker='
    <script>'
    script_start = rest.find(script_marker)
    if script_start != -1:
        script_start_abs = start + script_start + len('
    ')
        script_end = data.find('</script>', script_start_abs)
        if script_end != -1:
            script_end_abs = script_end + len('</script>')
            data = data[:script_start_abs - len('
    ')] + '
    <script src="js/app.js" defer></script>' + data[script_end_abs:]
path.write_text(data, encoding='utf-8')"
